title: m-2: manifest004-local-module-paths and cycle paths
description:
## Goal
#136: SCB-MANIFEST-004 must not report a use self::X::..., use crate::X::... or use super::X::... path as a use of the owned crate X when X is a local module. That is not a configured ownership violation (REQ-SCB-019).
## Deliverables
1. Replace the textual crate-name match in global_dependency_ownership with a syn-based first-segment rule over every path (syn::visit::Visit::visit_path: types, expressions, patterns, struct literals, trait bounds, impl headers, qualified paths, attributes) plus extern crate. A path is a use of crate X only when its first segment is X or ::X. Paths starting with self, crate or super are never uses of an owned crate. A bare X:: path is exempt when the same module declares mod X. Macro bodies keep the current textual rule.
2. Test manifest004_local_module_path, non-owner crate with a local mod cron: use self::cron::X, use super::cron::X, use crate::cron::X, use crate::commands::cron::X, a multi-line grouped use, nested group paths, and bare cron::X with a local mod cron report nothing.
3. Test manifest004_owned_crate_positions_still_reported: without a local mod, cron:: in a use, type, expression, pattern, struct literal, trait bound, impl header, qualified path, attribute and macro argument, plus ::cron::X and extern crate cron, are still reported; the same positions with self::, crate:: or super:: are not.
4. Regression replay of atm-core's crates/atm/src/commands/mod.rs (Cron(self::cron::CronCommand)) at 6ffaa97be as a committed fixture: zero findings.
5. Boundary package docs: an owner's integration tests are allowed by listing the owner's tests/ root in allowed_source_roots, with an example.
6. #385 (ADR-020 Amendment 2026-10-31, Pending Rand): include RuleId::ScbCycle001 in path_less_finding_excluded (lib.rs:722-735), alongside existing ScbCycle002/003, so exclude_paths_by_rule filters its node source paths. Test boundary_cycle_exclude_paths_by_rule with independent cycles in a.rs and b.rs: excluding SCB-CYCLE-001 on a.rs removes only that cycle.
## Does Not Close
No change to allowed_source_roots semantics, no new scope key, no exclusion and no consumer rename. Manifest ([dependencies]) ownership checks are unchanged.
## Active Trace
ANC-013. REQ-SCB-019, REQ-PRODUCT-023; ADR-020 decision 5 and Amendment 2026-10-31. ADR-022 is context, not a dispatch dependency.
design:
Baseline: manifest_dependency_policy/ownership.rs analyze() scans each source file; source_mentions_dependency() (71) and path_mentions() (84) match the crate name textually line by line, so self::cron::, doc comments and string literals all match. syn 2 (full, visit) is already a sc-lint-boundary dependency: parse the file, collect local mod names per module, implement Visit::visit_path and visit_item_extern_crate, and for Macro token streams apply path_mentions to the tokens' text. Doc comments and string literals no longer count as uses (tested). A file that fails to parse keeps the current textual behaviour (fail closed). Finding kind, RuleId and message unchanged.
#385 baseline: path_less_finding_excluded early-returns for SCB-CYCLE-001; node_paths/finding_source_paths and settings.excluded_by_any_path already implement 002/003 filtering. Extend the existing match to 001 and retain the existing finding wire shape; no cycle-detector or schema change.
Confine all legacy textual matching to source_mentions_dependency_textual_fallback(source: &str, dependency: &str) -> bool, called only for macro token bodies and whole-file parse failure. Successful AST parsing never falls back for ordinary paths, doc comments or string literals. Delete this fallback only when a separately approved macro/parse-error replacement preserves the same fail-closed tests; no silent relaxation. REQ-SCB-019 governs the ownership correction; ADR-022 is context only.
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- issue:#136: every exempt form in manifest004_local_module_path reports nothing; the atm-core commands/mod.rs replay reports nothing.
- REQ-SCB-019: every owned-crate position in manifest004_owned_crate_positions_still_reported is still reported; manifest ownership findings are unchanged; existing issue136 tests pass.
- Boundary docs show owner tests/ roots in allowed_source_roots as the supported configuration.
- issue:#385: boundary_cycle_exclude_paths_by_rule passes for two files/two cycles, preserving the non-excluded finding and existing 002/003 behavior.
- manifest004_macro_body_textual preserves the legacy macro-token check; manifest004_parse_failure_fails_closed proves malformed Rust retains textual findings; manifest004_doc_and_string_not_uses proves comments/string contents are not imports.
## Validation
- cargo test -p sc-lint-boundary --no-fail-fast
- just lint
- just test
Record the new tests failing on the develop baseline first.
